name: permission-checker
description: A permission checker for JS and TS with support for Node.js, Bun, and browsers

scripts.build:esm: mkdir -p dist/esm && cp src/index.ts dist/esm/ && bun build ./dist/esm/index.ts --outfile ./dist/esm/index.js --format esm --target browser --minify --sourcemap
scripts.build:cjs: mkdir -p dist/cjs && cp src/index.ts dist/cjs/ && bun build ./dist/cjs/index.ts --outfile ./dist/cjs/index.cjs --format cjs --target node --minify --sourcemap
scripts.build:types: mkdir -p dist/types && cp src/index.ts dist/types/ && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationMap --outDir dist/types dist/types/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run clean && mkdir -p dist && bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:types
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build
